purpose: latency and outcome counts; not an accuracy set
labels: none; the set holds IDs and content hashes only, no source text and no URL
selection: Per language (en, zh), over all rows of the source dataset: lengths are len(text_original) in Unicode code points; with n rows of the language sorted by length, cut point 1 is the ceil(n/3)-th and cut point 2 the ceil(2n/3)-th smallest length. Tercile 1: length <= cut point 1; tercile 2: cut point 1 < length <= cut point 2; tercile 3: length > cut point 2. Within each language and tercile, rows are ordered by the hexadecimal SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string "latency-benchmark-v1:<record_id>", ascending, and the first 10 are taken. ids.json lists the rows by language (en, zh), tercile (1 to 3), then that order.

fields.length_tercile: tercile of len(text_original) within its language, 1 (shortest) to 3
